sources.title: Government of Karnataka Draft GCC Policy 2024
sources.publisher: Department of Electronics, IT, Bt and S&T, Government of Karnataka

incentives.amount_text: Up to ₹1.0 Crore or 15% of eligible fixed capex
incentives.cap_text: Capped at ₹1.0 Cr for Tier 1 (Bengaluru); ₹2.5 Cr for Beyond Bengaluru clusters
incentives.conditions_text: Must create a minimum of 100 on-roll technical FTEs and sustain operations for 3 consecutive fiscal years.
incentives.headline_vs_reality: Policy headlines advertise large grants, but disbursement is retrospective, requiring audited annual filings and significant bureaucratic lead time.

incentives.amount_text: ₹1.50 per unit power subsidy for 5 years and 100% electricity duty exemption
incentives.conditions_text: Direct industrial or commercial power connection registered under parent Indian entity name in notified IT parks.
incentives.headline_vs_reality: Only accessible if occupying traditional independent leases; leased coworking and managed spaces cannot claim this subsidy directly.

policy_name: Telangana ICT Policy & GCC Acceleration Framework

sources.title: Telangana Information Communications Technology Policy Framework 2021-2026

incentives.amount_text: 25% lease rental subsidy for first 3 years of operations
incentives.conditions_text: Center must operate in government-designated IT corridors (HITEC City, Madhapur, Financial District) and hire 50+ local graduates.
incentives.headline_vs_reality: High claim success rate compared to other states due to TS-iPASS single-window portal, though payments are staggered across quarterly audit cycles.

incentives.amount_text: 100% reimbursement of patent filing fees up to ₹10 Lakhs
incentives.cap_text: ₹10 Lakhs per corporate entity per fiscal year
incentives.conditions_text: Patent must list the Indian captive entity and local engineers as principal inventors.
incentives.headline_vs_reality: Strictly limited to patents filed and granted under Indian Patent Office jurisdiction; international USPTO filings are excluded.

incentives.amount_text: 100% stamp duty exemption on commercial lease deeds
incentives.cap_text: Full waiver at time of lease registration
incentives.conditions_text: Registered commercial office lease minimum duration of 5 years in MIDC or designated IT parks.
incentives.headline_vs_reality: Immediate upfront cash savings on Day 1, making it one of the most practical and friction-free incentives in Western India.

policy_name: Tamil Nadu GCC Policy & R&D Incentives 2024

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Global Capability Centres Policy 2024
sources.publisher: Guidance Tamil Nadu, Government of Tamil Nadu

incentives.amount_text: ₹20,000 per employee training subsidy for local technical hires
incentives.cap_text: Capped at ₹20 Lakhs per GCC unit
incentives.conditions_text: Must complete verified 90-day training curriculum with state technical university partners.
incentives.headline_vs_reality: Administrative compliance overhead to document attendance and curriculum certifications frequently exceeds the net financial grant.
